description: Use this when someone runs or depends on several agents: give agents (a list of up to 60 token ids, slugs or bound wallets) or owner (a wallet: the Base registrations it holds now, the 60 newest, with the total). One row per agent with its level, last payment, whether its Agent Pass holds, the Watch reading of its newest payment, open incidents, standing unlimited approvals and approvals to plain accounts, detections in 30 days, blast radius, and the items worth a look; rows with something worth a look come first. Each row is that agent's self_check in short: open it for sources and measurement times. A clean row is not a statement that the agent is safe.

agents.description: Token ids, act_8453_N, slugs or bound wallets

owner.description: Or a 0x wallet: the registrations it holds
